# slackapp_vim_app (Resource)

A Slack app, installed in the workspace of the provider's `service_token`, whose bot token and signing secret are written to a named secret in a Vim account's vault and nowhere else: not to state and not to the plan. State keeps the secret's `vscrt_` token and a hash of the bot token.

Destroy deletes the app but not the vault secret, since the Vim platform app may not delete one. Creating the app again under the same `vault_secret_name` fails until the secret is deleted in Vim.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) A JSON app manifest encoded as a string. It has no icon: set `icon_path`. A change that adds bot scopes installs the app again.
- `vault_secret_name` (String) Name of the vault secret. It must be unique in the account.
- `vim_account_id` (String) The Vim account whose vault holds the secret.
- `vim_base_url` (String) Base URL of the Vim backend whose vault holds the secret, such as `https://api.getvim.ai`. It is https, or http on `localhost` or `127.0.0.1`.

### Optional

- `collaborators` (Set of String) Slack user IDs, such as `U0123ABCD`, of the people who may manage the app at https://api.slack.com/apps, beside the service token's user, who owns it and is never listed. Each is added as an owner, and a collaborator not listed is removed, including one added in Slack. Unset, the provider leaves the collaborators as they are.
- `icon_path` (String) Path of the app icon: a PNG, JPEG or GIF of 512 to 2000 pixels per side. It is set when its contents change, judged by `icon_sha256`.
- `vault_consumers` (Set of String) The services that may reveal the secret, each `<service>:<name>`.

### Read-Only

- `bot_id` (String) The app's bot.
- `bot_token_ref` (String) Reference to the bot token in the vault: `vscrt_<token>@botToken`.
- `bot_token_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the bot token in the vault.
- `bot_user_id` (String) The app's bot user.
- `icon_image_url` (String) The URL Slack serves the icon at. A new URL means the icon changed.
- `icon_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the icon last set. Null when no icon is set, or when the icon was changed in Slack.
- `id` (String) The app ID.
- `signing_secret_ref` (String) Reference to the signing secret in the vault: `vscrt_<token>@signingSecret`.
- `team_id` (String) The workspace the app is installed in.
- `vault_secret_token` (String) The vault secret's `vscrt_` token.
